#general > Talos: A Formal Verification Framework for WebAssembly @ 💬
Maybe some people would be interested in porting iris-wasm to lean and combining with @Marcelo Fornet Talos.

Hi, I'm currently looking into iris-lean, since we will need this in some form and it doesnt' make sense to have a new alternative. iris-wasm would be interesting though, is there any effort in this directions (iris-wasm in lean)
I'm not sure anyone is already working on this, but it fits the general effort of porting iris logics to lean. With many of the other logics already done, it may not be too hard...
